body.name: Global-CID
body.construction: Given a certified paired response-table compressor satisfying the collision-compression handle and a certified terminating saturation satisfying the ranked fixing-overlap handle, enumerate \(\mathfrak R(H)\) and run ordinary ID on every refinement. If a local run fails, apply the supplied compressor to its hedge witness. Otherwise apply the supplied saturation to the local formulas. Return the resulting common guarded circuit or cross-refinement collision certificate after exact checks of graph compatibility, positivity, full observed-law equality, branch coverage, overlap common-value identities, denominator safety, latent support, and target separation.
